---
title: "Robotic Arm Pattern Formation"
subtitle: "Python-controlled pick-and-place system for particle assembly"
---

## Key insight

Automated manipulation of discrete particles requires reliable control of:

- positioning  
- gripping  
- placement accuracy  

This project demonstrates a simple and robust system for **automated particle assembly using a robotic arm**.

---

## System

- Robotic arm with vacuum end-effector  
- Python-controlled pick-and-place sequence  
- Target: generate predefined patterns from individual particles  

---

## What I did

- Developed Python control logic for robotic arm motion  
- Implemented pick-and-place pipeline using suction-based gripping  
- Generated structured patterns (e.g., Yin–Yang)  
- Tested system on spherical and irregular particles  

---

## Methods & tools

- **Control:** Python-based command pipeline  
- **Actuation:** vacuum suction gripping system  
- **Task:** discrete particle manipulation and placement  

---

## Key results

### 1. Stable particle manipulation

- Reliable pick-and-place using pressure-based gripping  

---

### 2. Pattern generation

- Successfully reproduced predefined geometric patterns  

---

### 3. Generality

- System works for both regular and irregular particle shapes  

---

## Takeaway

This project shows how simple control systems can enable **automated manipulation of discrete particles**, bridging simulation and physical systems.
